paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Israel Chingtu Kilembawlte

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israelte belamchingte tung ah thu gen in, thu gen inla, akiang uah, belamchingte kiang mahmah ah, huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Israelte belam-ching, amau kivak maimahte tung agik hi; belamchingte'n belamte vak lou ding ahi uhia?
Athaute na ne ua, amul in na kizem ua; athauthau na gou ua, belamte na vak kei uhi.
Natna veite, avakmangte na hon pi kei ua; amangte na zong kei ua; khauhtak leh na mahmah in na thunun zaw uh.
Belampute a-om louh ziak un dalhsak in ana omta ua; ana dalh ua, gam sahangte an lel ahong hita uhi.
Ka belamte tang chih leh mual chih ah avakmang ua; ahi, ka belamte leitung tengteng ah ana dalh khin uh; limsakmi leh zongmi a-om kei uh, chi in gen in," achi hi.
Huaiziak in belamchingte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;

Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, belamching a-om louh ua, belamchingte'n ka belamte azon louh ua, belamchingte'n ka belamte avak louh ua, amau akivak zawksop ziak un ka belamte gam sahangte an lel ahong hi ua; ka belamte samat lel ahong hi petmah uh.
Huaiziak in nou belamchingte aw, TOUPA thu za un.

Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Ngai un, belamchingte ka dou ahi; akhut ua kipan ka belamte ka sut ding a, ka belamte akepna uh ka tawpsak ding a, belamchingte leng amau akivakta kei ding uh; a-angsung ua kipan ka belamte ka lakhe ding a, amau dia nek ding ahih nawnlouhna ding un, chi in.
Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi ngal a: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in ka zong ding a, ka zongkhe ding hi.
heading: Belamchingpa Hoih

paite: Belamching in abelam dalhte lak a abelamhonte azon lai bang in ka belamte ka zongkhe ding; khonim ni leh mial nuai a adalhna tengteng ua kipan ka zongkhe ding,
Huan mite lak a kipan ka lakhe ding a; gam chih a kipan ka kaikhawm ding a; amau gam ngei ah ka pilut ding; Israel tangte ah, lui geite ah, mi tenna mun tengtengte ah ka tasak ding.
Loupa hoihna munte ah ka tasak ding a; ahuangsung uh Israel tang sangte ah a-om ding; huang hoihtak sung ah leng a-om ding ua, Israel tang tung a loupa dawng munte ah ata ding uh.
Kei mahmah in ka belamte ka vak ding a; ka kualsak kinken ding a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Amang ka zong ding a, delhmangte ka pikik nawn ding a, akhe kitante uh ka tuam ding a, ka hatsak ding; athau leh ahatte leng ka ching ding a; diktak in ka vak ding hi.
Huan nou tungthu ahihleh, aw ka belamhonte, hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Ngai un, ka belamte kal thu ka gensak ding a, belamtalte, keltalte leng.
Gantatna mun hoihtak tung a tat nou ding in thil bang tham lou bang alang in, na tatna neihsun na chilse zosop uh ahi maw?
Huan tuichim mahmahte na dawn khit un na ngap nin mawkmawk uh ahi maw? Ka belamte'n na siksa uh ane un, na ngahsa uh adawn ding uh maw?
Huaiziak in hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in akiang uah achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in gan gawngte leh gan thaute kal thu ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
Ahatloute na liang un leh na sikte un na phu ua, na khete un na pik ua, na dalhsak uhi.
Huaiziak in ka belamte ka humbit ding; samat lel ahi nawn kei ding ua, belamte kal thu ka gensak ding hi.
Huan atung uah belamchingpa khat, ka sikhapa David ngei ka koih ding a; ama'n amaute avak ding a; amah amau chingpa ahi ding a, amaute avak ding hi.
Huchi in kei a Toupa PATHIAN uh ka hi ding a, ka nasempa David atung ua heutu ahi ding; kei TOUPA ngei in ka chita hi.
Amau toh lemna thukhun ka bawl ding a, sahangte gam a kipan ka hihmang ding; gamdai ah leng bittak in ateng ding ua, gammang nuaite ah a-ihmu hithit ding uhi.
Amau leh ka mual kim munte ka vualzawl ding a; ahun geihgeih in vuah ka zusak ding a, vualzawl vuahte azu ding hi.

Huan gam a sing in gah asuah ding a, lei in apunna asuah ding a; agam uah bittak in a-om ding uh; ahakkolte uh ka kitansak a, sikha a bawl mite khut a kipan ka hutkhiak hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
Namdangte samat lel ahi nawnta kei ding ua, gam sahangte nekmang mai ahi nawn kei ding uh; bittak in a-om zawta ding ua, kuamah in alausak ngei nawn kei ding uh.
Thilsuan minthang mahmah ka bawlsak ding a; huai gam ah kial in ahihmang nawn kei ding a, namdangte muhsitna leng athuak nawn kei ding uh.
Huan kei TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah ka om chih athei un, amau Israel inkote leng ka mite ahi uh chih athei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huan nou ka belamte, ka gantatna mun a belamte na hi ua; kei na Pathian uh ka hi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in.
